scene.background: dense grove of tall, lush palm trees with long, arching fronds
scene.lighting: bright, natural daylight with soft shadows under the huts
scene.style: photorealistic, resembling a high-resolution photograph taken with a DSLR or mirrorless camera

reflection.colors: vivid colors of the huts—especially the yellow and red
